feeds.title: Valarie Kaur Blog
feeds.description: VALARIE KAUR is a renowned civil rights leader, lawyer, award-winning filmmaker, educator, innovator, and best-selling author of SEE NO STRANGER. She leads the Revolutionary Love Project to reclaim love as a force for justice. Valarie's vision of 'Revolutionary Love' is deeply rooted in her Sikh faith. She grew up on the farmlands of California, where her family has lived as Punjabi Sikh farmers for more than a century.

feeds.title: Sikh And Dread Blog
feeds.description: We are Dalbir & Rotimi. Collectively, we have over 20 years of experience in wedding photography, portrait photography, and fashion photography. We were both pursuing our own photography passions prior to us forming our company, Sikh & dread photography In 2011. Discover exquisite wedding photography in our blog. We cover Asian, Indian, Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, faith, or non-faith weddings.

feeds.title: Sikh Museum Initiative Blog
feeds.description: Sikh Museum Initiative focuses on locating and uncovering relics and documents which bind the two communities together. This national program will leave a lasting legacy for future generations so that second-generation Sikhs will understand the close relationship that exists. We aim to create a digital platform for Sikh exhibits. We give lectures on shared Sikh and British history.

feeds.title: Sikh Wisdom
feeds.description: We welcome you to sikhwisdom.org - a place to participate in informative discussions to strengthen your knowledge. We have created a platform that allows people all over the world to connect. It's a safe space to network, and share your knowledge with those who seek it, and a place that brings people together with different viewpoints.

feeds.title: The Sikh Foundation International
feeds.description: The Sikh Foundation was founded in 1967 by Dr. Narinder S Kapany, to promote the heritage and future of Sikhism. It is a non-profit non-political charitable organization. The Foundation works to pass on the essence of Sikh heritage to the growing Sikh diaspora in the west, particularly the youth.

feeds.title: Sikh Philosophy Network
feeds.description: Sikh Philosophy Network is a place for disucssions on Sikh Sikhi Sikhism with intellectuals.

feeds.title: Sikh Dharma International Blog
feeds.description: Sikh Dharma International Blog - includes articles and videos from the Sikh Dharma community and Sikh Dharma Ministers. It also includes many lectures and videos by Siri Singh Sahib and Yogi Bhajan. The goal of this blog is to share inspirations from the Sikh spiritual path which are relevant to All.

feeds.title: The World Sikh News
feeds.description: We are the fu­ture of Sikh jour­nal­ism - a unique plat­form for views and per­spec­tives, un­prece­dented in the Sikh world. WSN per­ceives events, philoso­phies and po­lit­ical de­vel­op­ments through the prism of the Sikh faith commu­nity so that the com­mu­nity is proud of the web­site and the web­site, in lieu, keeps the com­mu­ni­ty's faith alive.

feeds.title: Sikh Coalition Blog
feeds.description: Through the community, courtrooms, classrooms, and halls of Congress, we work to protect the constitutional right to practice your faith without fear. We strive to do this with integrity, selflessness, and the belief that our shared work holds a greater purpose. We provide professional expertise, leadership, and impact that better protects your civil rights today and for the generations that follow.

feeds.title: Gurbani Blog
feeds.description: Since its inception in 1993, the author (T. Singh) decided to keep this website non-commercial - NOT to sell/commercialize the Spiritual Wisdom of the Sri Guru Granth Sahib (SGGS) and use it as a mundane business as many are doing just that in the name of the Gurbani, Gurmat, Gurus, and Sikhi. This website is created to educate people about Gurbani and Sikhism.

feeds.title: Sikh Formations Blog
feeds.description: Sikh Formations Podcast-Webinar-Blog is a forum where you can access interviews, talks, and debates with scholars, activists, and artists working broadly in the field of Sikh and Punjab Studies. The aim of the Sikh Formations Podcast-Blog-Webinar is to widen access to scholarly research in the field of Sikh and Punjab studies and make it available to the wider public.

feeds.title: Sikh Sangat News
feeds.description: Sikh Sangat News is a blog that was created with the intention to connect Punjabis worldwide. Get news about Sikhs from all around the world.

feeds.title: The Sikh News Network
feeds.description: The Sikh News Network is dedicated to providing you with news related to Sikhism. We cover news from Asia, Europe, and America.

feeds.title: Sikh Soldie Organization Blog
feeds.description: Sikh Soldie Organization commemorates the heroism of Sikh soldiers in the two World Wars. It also provides news related to Sikhism.

feeds.title: We Are Sikhs Blog
feeds.description: We Are Sikhs is on a mission to educate our fellow citizens about the peaceful, progressive, and tolerant community of over half a million Sikhs who live in the United States. Turban Talk Blog is dedicated to sharing Sikh history, lifestyle, and interesting facts.

feeds.title: The Sikh Lounge
feeds.description: The Sikh Lounge is home to the youth for their opinions, ideas, and original reporting for the Panja. We pulish news and history of the Sikh culture. Find stroies from the very beginning of Sikhism to till date.

feeds.title: Journey Of A Sikher Blog
feeds.description: Journey Of A Sikher Blog tells you the story of a Sikh boy struggling through childhood in a land where he feels unaccepted and is bullied. He shares his experiences, thoughts and reflections in this blog.

feeds.title: Sikh Career Growth Blog
feeds.description: 'Sikh Career Growth' is a group of corporate professionals who are inspired and motivated by Guru Granth Sahib ji's (Sikh's living Guru) teachings and our illustrious ancestors to continue the heritage of selfless service to society through everything we have accomplished so far. We are a non-profitable organization with a VISION to promote a balance between human & professional values so that there is harmony across the ecosystem. We share some insightful career-reflective blogs for corporate growth aspirants.

feeds.title: Sikh Forgiveness Blog
feeds.description: Sikh Forgiveness is a place for the community to voice their mental health journey, and share their experiences, opinions, and solutions surrounding mental health. Our members and contributors break down stigma barriers and speak with an open heart and open mind. We support by working with charities, building networks, and providing perspective to seek support for the community.
